# Botnoi AI Gateway API

Base URL: https://api-voice.botnoi.ai
Auth: Bearer <_bn_token>
OpenAPI: /openapi.json

## VIDEO AI MODELS
- POST /api/genai/wavespeed/bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video — Create Seedance 2.5 video
- GET  /api/genai/wavespeed/result/{id} — Get Seedance 2.5 result
- POST /api/genai/byteplus/video-generation — Create SeeDance 2.0 video
- GET  /api/genai/byteplus/video-generation/{task_id} — Get SeeDance 2.0 result
- POST /api/genai/motion-control — Create Motion Control video
- GET  /api/genai/get_id_wavspeed — Get Motion Control result

## AVATAR LIP-SYNC
- POST /api/genai/infinitetalk — Create InfiniteTalk avatar
- GET  /api/genai/get_id_wavspeed — Get InfiniteTalk result
- POST /api/genai/byteplus/avatar-video — Create OmniHuman avatar
- GET  /api/genai/byteplus/avatar-video/{task_id} — Get OmniHuman result

## IMAGE GENERATION
- POST /api/genai/byteplus/image-generation — Create SeeDream 4.5 image
- GET  /api/genai/byteplus/image-generation/status/{task_id} — Get SeeDream 4.5 result

## GPT IMAGE STUDIO
- POST /api/genai/wavespeed/gpt-image/text-to-image — Create GPT Image (Text to Image)
- POST /api/genai/upload_image — Upload image for editing
- POST /api/genai/wavespeed/gpt-image/edit — Edit image with prompt
- GET  /api/genai/wavespeed/result/{id} — Get GPT Image result
